theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (m + 1 + k))) (ι : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (s h : ℝ) (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ x : Euclid (m + 1 + k), ∃ v : Euclid (m + 1), ∃ w : Euclid k, x = ι v + ι' w) → 0 < h → ContinuousOn u (ball 0 s) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s, u v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h) → {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} ⊆ U → IsSmoothForm ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s → ∃ φ : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1 + k)) m) ⊆ {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s, (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1 + k)) m) =ᶠ[𝓝 (z + ι v + ι' (u v))] affinePullbackForm (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap) (-(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap z)) ψ
